messages:
maya: Quick design review note for Console > Compliance: the Data Retention card now shows a compact chip '90d' next to region. Two issues: 1) keyboard users can't reach the info 'i' tooltip — tab skips it; 2) the KMS label says 'Managed key' but reads like a link/button; also low contrast in light theme. Fig share: https://figma.com/s/retention-card-v3 :eyes:

sam: Good catch. Tooltip should be tabbable (tabindex=0) and have aria-describedby. We also need aria-live for region changes so screen readers announce 'Region: us-west-2 (fallback)'.

robin: Copy nit: '90d' is terse and confusing in support emails. Suggest UI show '90 days' and keep '90d' in compact contexts only. Backend audit strings must remain stable — coordinate with infra teams before changing server-emitted text.

ana: Noted. I'll open INF-2011 to track audit-key deprecation if we change server text. For now we can change UI only and leave audit logs as-is. Need 2-release notice if we change log formats.

leo: On KMS label: if it's non-actionable, make it plain text with lock icon and role="status" + aria-label="encryption: managed". If we plan to allow key management from there later, convert to a button but update contrast now. Proposed link color #0B5FFF and badge text #0F1724.

robin: SVG sparkline in the card lacks a <title>. Add <title> and role="img" with description like 'Preview: default retention 90 days'. And ensure it has focusable=false so it doesn't trap keyboard users.

maya: small accessibility suggestion: retention chip should be focusable (role=button) and toggles an expanded timeline when Enter/Space is pressed. Add aria-expanded on the chip. Also ensure the info tooltip is next in tab order after region selector.

sam: Tests: some E2E tests assert exact text 'Region: Auto' — if we change UI to 'Region: Automatic (fallback)' we'll need to update tests. I'll file QA ticket INF-2012 to coordinate test updates and release timing.

ana: Also flagging customers who parse audit logs. I'll add a note in the release notes if we ever change the audit string.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/retention-card-a11y (sha: e7f9a2) :package:

maya: I'll update the Figma with focus states, add aria attributes in the PR, and call out which bits are UI-only. PR today, will request security and audit reviews.

leo: One more UX tweak: hover on the chip should show human readable text 'Data retained for 90 days' — helps brief scans. Keep chip compact by default.

robin: Agreed. After PR lands run axe and a quick keyboard-only pass in QA.

maya: thanks everyone — I'll land the changes and ping the channel when CI passes.
